build_gaussian_timeout_simulator: build a GaussianTimeOutSimulator to simulate per-example training time with Gaussian distribution
create_never_timeout_simulator: create a NeverTimeOutSimulator that returns zero training time and never times out
simulate_training_time: simulate training time on one client given device performance and number of samples
track_training_time_distribution: track the empirical training time distribution and compute sample mean and variance per user
check_user_timeout: check if a user has timed out by comparing training time against the per-round wall clock limit
